The Subtask Name: Initial Search and Identification of Paternal Grandfather
Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: Identify the paternal grandfather of Alexandre Berthier, 3rd Prince of Wagram
Evidence: WebSurfer searches for "Alexandre Berthier 3rd Prince of Wagram" and finds he is the grandson of Louis Alexandre Berthier; Planner confirms this lineage.

The Subtask Name: Verification of Lineage via Wikipedia
Step Range: 3-10
The Oracle: Verify the genealogical chain (1st Prince -> 2nd Prince -> 3rd Prince) using Wikipedia pages
Evidence: WebSurfer searches for Wikipedia pages of Alexandre Berthier (3rd), Napoléon Alexandre Berthier (2nd), Louis-Alexandre Berthier (1st), and Princes of Wagram; Planner analyzes results noting a discrepancy in the 2nd Prince's parentage on one source but confirming the overall lineage.

The Subtask Name: Cross-Verification with Genealogical Sources
Step Range: 11-20
The Oracle: Cross-check the lineage with ThePeerage and Geni to resolve discrepancies and confirm the paternal grandfather
Evidence: Planner instructs WebSurfer to check ThePeerage and Geni entries for all three princes; WebSurfer attempts to access Louis-Alexandre Berthier's page again (repeating the URL) while the Planner continues to analyze the need for cross-verification and synthesis of a final answer.
